meta.title: Basira AI — See what your data is trying to tell you

hero.subheadline: Drop in a spreadsheet or a PDF and Basira reads it, charts it, and answers your questions in plain Arabic or English — no formulas required.
hero.trust_line: No spreadsheet skills needed · Your files stay private
hero.mock_insight: Revenue is up 18% in the East region, driven mostly by August.

dashboardMock.insightsText: Sales show a strong upward trend in Q2 and Q3. East and North regions drive 68% of total revenue.

banner.title: Ask it. Basira answers — from your file, not a guess.
banner.subtitle: Move your cursor across the panel, or just watch: this is the same kind of answer Basira gives once your file is uploaded.
ticker: Which month had the highest sales?
Summarize this report in three lines.
Show me rows with missing values.
What's driving the drop in March?

upload.title: Start with a file, not a blank page
upload.subtitle: Excel, CSV, or PDF — up to 500MB. Basira handles the reading; you ask the questions.
upload.dropzone_title: Drag files here, or click to browse
upload.multiple_hint: Drop several files at once — each gets its own dashboard
upload.askTogetherHint: {{count}} files ready — ask about them together
upload.error_generic: Something went wrong while uploading. Please try again.
upload.error_network: Can't reach the server. Is the backend running?
upload.error_type: Unsupported file type. Use XLSX, XLS, CSV, or PDF.

features.title: Everything you'd do in a spreadsheet, minus the spreadsheet
features.subtitle: Basira reads structure and meaning at once — rows and columns for data files, headings and tables for PDFs.

items.title: Instant statistics
items.description: Row and column counts, missing values, duplicates, and data types — calculated the moment your file lands.

items.title: Charts without formulas
items.description: Basira picks the right chart for your data and builds pie, line, bar, and scatter views automatically.

items.title: PDF, actually read
items.description: Text, tables, and headings are extracted so reports and contracts become searchable, summarized documents.

items.title: Ask in plain language
items.description: "Which month had the highest sales?" gets answered directly from your own file, not a generic guess.

items.title: Anomalies, flagged
items.description: Basira surfaces the outlier row, the missing quarter, the number that doesn't match the rest.

items.title: Built to switch languages
items.description: Arabic and English, right to left or left to right, with no reload and no layout breaking.

dashboardPreview.title: One screen, the whole file explained
dashboardPreview.subtitle: Summary, charts, statistics, and AI insights land in the same view the moment processing finishes.
dashboardPreview.insight_text: Sales dipped 9% in March, tracking a known regional supply delay.

chatPreview.title: Talk to your file like it's a colleague
chatPreview.subtitle: Every answer is grounded in the file you uploaded — with the exact rows behind it, one click away.
chatPreview.user_msg: Which product line underperformed this quarter?
chatPreview.ai_msg: Home Appliances, down 12% versus Q2 — mainly the July–August period. Want the breakdown by city?

howItWorks.title: From file to answer in three steps
howItWorks.subtitle: No setup, no data modeling — just upload and ask.

steps.title: Upload
steps.description: Drag in an Excel, CSV, or PDF file. Basira detects its structure automatically.

steps.title: Analyze
steps.description: Rows, columns, and text are parsed, cleaned, and charted in seconds.

steps.title: Ask
steps.description: Chat with the file directly and get answers, summaries, and recommendations.

steps.title: Decide
steps.description: Act on clear, sourced answers instead of digging through rows yourself.

footer.tagline: AI-powered file analysis that turns spreadsheets and PDFs into clear, plain-language insights.

newsletter.title: Stay updated
newsletter.subtitle: Product news and tips, a couple of times a month.
